title: HR system returns a server error straight after sign-in

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I can sign in to the HR system and then it throws 'Error 500' on the landing
page every time. Tried Edge and Chrome, and my phone.

A colleague in the same team is fine on hers, which is the odd part.

Everything I do today is in there.

Mel

handling.escalation_reason: No runbook covers the HR system, and a per-user server error needs someone with access to its logs.

rationale: Nothing in the pinned knowledge base covers a third-party HR system, and a 500 for one user and not another is a server-side question nobody can answer from the ticket (G6). She has ruled out the browser and the device herself, which is exactly the information that makes this a person's job rather than a clarifying question. Her whole day's work is in there and there is no workaround, so P2 (G1).
